description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. Loku Ederage Sandun Rathnayaka of the Welivitiya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his office of the Member
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Welivitiya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This is an electoral matter directly related to the composition of a local government body, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) for content concerning electoral processes, candidate status, and declarations related to local authority elections.
